title: material hit puffs
why: His pick 80: wall hits should look like the material heard in v23.84. Watch: shoot wood, brick and metal in both windows; look for tan splinters, brief dust and short sparks, with no effects through fog.
now: A few short-lived splinters, dust puffs or sparks use matOf, including teammate tracers. Eight bursts per frame, cosmetic randomness only. LOCAL: no linked review.
